question: Where did Mahatma Gandhi preside over the annual session of the Indian National Congress for the first and the last time?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Belgaum**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1924, Mahatma Gandhi presided **over the Belgaum session** of the Indian National Congress. 
 
• The Belgaum session was the only Congress session presided over by Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• **Gandhiji** became the president of the Indian National Congress in 1924 and showed great respect to the land by touching its soil immediately after landing there.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **In Surat Session (1907),** The Radicals or Extremists wanted Lala Lajpat Rai or Tilak as a presidential candidate, and the Moderates supported Rash Behari Ghosh to be the President.
 
• But Lala Lajpat Rai stepped down and Rash Behari Ghosh became the President.
 
• In 1939, this Session of Congress was held at Tripuri which is a small town situated in the state of Madhya Pradesh. This session is famous as in this Pattabhi Sitaramayya was standing against Subhas Chandra Bose. Pattabhi Sitaramayya was the closest candidate appointed by Mahatma Gandhi on his behalf.
 
• In 1920, the Nagpur session of Congress adopted a resolution for the **Non-Cooperation Movement under the leadership of Mahatma Gandhi.**
